household.name: Our Household
household.note: Pooled finances: all accounts merge into one ledger, no per-person split.

settings._lang_note: Page language: 'en' or 'zh-Hans'. Currency is independent - set currency to USD, CNY, EUR, GBP, TWD, HKD etc. Override per run with --lang / --currency.
settings._email_note: email_from is your Gmail address. email_to / email_cc / email_bcc accept a single address or a list. The app password is NEVER stored here - it lives in a file you point at with --password-file. See scripts/send_report.py.

note: Discretionary spending envelopes, in cents per month. Fixed commitments (mortgage, car loan, daycare) belong in fixed_expenses.json, not here. Run `python3 -m budget propose-budget` to fill this from actuals.
